prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web app direction comp, 1440x900 landscape
Primary request: Design SafeDay as The Lit Window, a radically minimal outdoor-planning interface inspired by seven-segment clocks and platform indicators without becoming retro novelty.
Structure: a slim header with SafeDay and a compact place control; one near-black continuous field; one monumental amber recommendation reading exactly "Tomorrow" and "7:00 to 9:00 AM" with "Best for a walk"; a short plain-language reason; compact real metrics 24 C, Rain 1%, Air 82 AQI, UV 1.0; later windows occupy fixed dim ghost slots below; a seven-day rail stays visible; activity change is one compact inline control.
Style/medium: polished production UI mockup, matte display glass, ghost segments, careful editorial spacing, minimal consumer tool.
Color palette: #161816 ground, #d79a3b amber light, #393d38 ghost cells, readable warm-white secondary text.
Text (verbatim): "SafeDay"; "Tomorrow"; "7:00 to 9:00 AM"; "Best for a walk"; "Good air and almost no rain."; "24 C"; "Rain 1%"; "Air 82 AQI"; "UV 1.0".
Constraints: make the task obvious in one second; very few buttons and fields; accessible contrast; compact header; no card grid; no fake browser chrome; no giant buttons; no giant Privacy button; no generic weather icon grid; no gradients; no em dash or en dash; no decorative dots; no alarm or hazard styling.
Avoid: dashboard clutter, multicolor status cards, neon glow, cyberpunk, command-center aesthetics, made-up claims, illegible microtype, mobile phone frame.
